en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a ski jumping competition, with spectators and officials present. The text on the photograph indicates the event is 'Vinteridrottsfesten i Sundsvall 1908. Backtävlingen,' which translates to 'Winter sports festival in Sundsvall 1908. The ski jumping competition.' The postcard's reverse side includes handwritten correspondence in Swedish, a Swedish postage stamp, and postal details.
